findings.description: CON-SUP-132 specifies that the three pins are inputs held low by external board pull-down resistors from reset until software configures them. SYS-SUP-020 requires the outputs low and SYS-SUP-053 requires their subsequent configuration, but neither captures the specified board mechanism or pin state. CON-SUP-133 also specifies a board output-stage delay of at most 1 ms; SYS-SUP-052 sets the 49 ms pin deadline without capturing that board obligation.
findings.requested_change: Address the reset-time pin and pull-down behavior and the output-stage delay as system obligations or explicitly disposition them as platform assumptions, with traceability to CON-SUP-132 and CON-SUP-133.

findings.description: CON-SUP-001 identifies the target microcontroller and CON-SUP-004 specifies C11. SYS-SUP-040 requires operation on a simulator, and SYS-SUP-041 covers allocation and recursion, but the set does not address or disposition the target microcontroller or language constraints.
findings.requested_change: Address or explicitly disposition the target microcontroller and C11 constraints, with traceability to CON-SUP-001 and CON-SUP-004.
